cases.bias_update: At each completed calibration cycle, b_next=clip(b_current+delta_stored_battery_energy_J/period_s,-50000,0). Uses only past full-cycle energy; freeze at first 3 consecutive qualifying cycles or after 12 calibration cycles, then confirm at least 3 whole cycles.
cases.bias_causal_availability: Requires exact simulated stored-energy change and a known periodic forcing clock. It is an instrumented existence/calibration check, not a validated noisy BMS estimator or novel service controller.
cases.purpose: Loss-compensated signed periodic target-orbit existence check; negative mean PCC power supplies losses

steady_rule.energy_exclusion: Battery inventory and cumulative energy integrals are excluded from electrical orbit convergence but recorded with their known finite-discharge or charge trend and SoC hard bounds.

recovery_rule.sag_target: Full normalized pre-fault checkpoint state at every sample, in nominal source frame; compare the converged pre-fault cycle template if needed. Battery energy/cumulative integrals excluded but accounted.
recovery_rule.step_target: Converged new finite operating state: full state cycles separated by 50 ms, same rule; not old P/Q setpoint.
recovery_rule.limiter_release: All current-reference allocation, modulation, battery-source-command clipping and PLL frequency clipping absent throughout final 150 ms. Report last active sample and release delay.
recovery_rule.success: Report separately: complete simulation; all post-checkpoint hard limits safe; restored electrical/controller state; limiter release. Complete safe recovery requires all.

periodic_rule.compare: Every sample state against same-phase sample in preceding full 1 s cycle; includes current, DC energy, battery terminal/source command, PLL angle relative to source, integrators, applied/queued modulation and held frequency.
periodic_rule.confirmation_success: 3 consecutive full cycles after bias frozen, each full-state cycle difference <=1e-5 and |stored battery energy delta|<=1 J, hard safe, and all limiters inactive; retain bias and all calibration history.
periodic_rule.prewarm: First safe converged b=0,Q=0 finite equilibrium under common 50ms rule, max5s, then sine starts at phase0 on its controller-clock checkpoint.
periodic_rule.pll_periodic_rule: No instantaneous 1 mHz nominal-frequency requirement during ongoing signed forcing; require bounded frequency, periodic full PLL state, and zero mean PLL frequency drift within1mHz over final cycle.
periodic_rule.limits_of_claim: Finite numerical evidence for a repeating loss-compensated averaged-model orbit, not a proof of infinite-time invariance or a field calibration.

numerical.primary: DOP853 nominal dq; rtol1e-10 atol1e-8; exact control/event boundaries
numerical.adaptive_refinement_rule: Any new case within 0.001 pu actual-current or DC hard boundary, or within0.001 relative AC S/P hard boundary, is repeated at5us under identical conditions; counted as numerical refinement, not new condition.
numerical.event_checks: Actual-current crossings, emergency1.1pu, Vdc bounds and SoC bounds. Record all safety breaches; emergency/DC/SoC crossings terminate.

storage.ordinary: Compressed100us endpoint plant/controller/normalized-state traces plus each interval internal-solver extrema, safety and saturation bits, convergence log and full checkpoint. No duplicate dense ordinary5us trace unless boundary rule triggers.
storage.sag: Retain all primary10us internal trajectory rows and full100us state/control records for all three sag conditions; retain5us raw sag0475, and same independentabc representative records.
storage.periodic: Preserve all100us endpoint/full-state records and per-interval extrema for calibration+confirmation, all bias/cycle energy logs, final full plant/controller checkpoint; no routine5us duplicate.
storage.provenance: New experiment, not restored historical evidence. Append new files only; preserve complete prior archive and its hashes.

boundary_selection.rule: 150ms sag; low-conflict retained0.85 and0.75 plus rounded-up near-boundary0.475, selected from source/RL all-strategy necessary-energy certificate before dynamic extension runs.
boundary_selection.interpretation: Positive necessary margin means this particular necessary inequality does not exclude feasibility. It is not an inner feasible-set certificate.
